title: Identity-inserted common section diagram
statement: The two morphisms in the abelian common section diagram remain equal after postcomposition with the identity of the section homology of K.

proof.text: Construct the concrete standard lift beta0 with source J0=injectiveResolution(f_*F). Lift the identity from D.J to J0 by InjectiveResolution.desc. The augmentation equation for the concrete lift and D.compatible identify the composites of D.beta and desc followed by beta0 with the augmentation of D.J. Extend by zero to integers; uniqueness into the bounded-below injective complex D.K gives a homotopy. Applying sections and homology identifies their maps.

Apply the existing public acyclicComparison_naturality theorem to the forgotten identity lift. Cancel the inverse of the acyclic-resolution comparison to obtain forward naturality, then compose with the fixed Ext and sections isomorphisms defining abelianResolutionIso. Substitute this forward naturality and the homology equality into the left composite. Apply the standard-source calculation, then postcompose with the identity. No duplicate inverse-naturality declaration is introduced.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01FB, 015E and 013S; arbitrary-source and lift independence via the imported public acyclic comparison API, followed by the standard-source Ext calculation. Repair removes the duplicate private inverse-naturality lemma.

theorem abelianEdge_section_diagram_after_identity {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (F : X.Modules)
    (D : ModuleCohomologyFMapData f ((pushforward f).obj F) F
      (𝟙 ((pushforward f).obj F))) (p : ℕ) :
    ((abelianResolutionIso Y D.J p).hom ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map
          (((moduleSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map D.β)) ≫
        𝟙 ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).obj
          (((moduleSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.K)) =
      (abelianEdgeHom f F p ≫ (abelianResolutionIso X D.I p).hom ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map
          (D.a.hom ≫
            ((moduleSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map D.lambda)) ≫
        𝟙 ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).obj
          (((moduleSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.K))
